szenen.text: Breaking: the US Securities and Exchange Commission is investigating Nvidia. The focus: Nvidia's accounting.
The S&P 500 fell below seven thousand for the first time since April fifteenth. The Nasdaq one hundred was down more than four percent.
The probe is confidential. The SEC declined to comment, Nvidia has not responded. And the Justice Department is already reviewing its twelve point nine billion dollar Hugging Face deal.
Our view: Nvidia lost its CEO, the banks went dark, and now the SEC. Nvidia carried this whole market. The cracks are getting bigger.
